text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains or losses are not enough to judge my decisions; I should keep a long-term, risk-conscious perspective.","My repeated sales of Stock B as its price rose reduced that holding, but I should not assume that selling winners is always right; consider each stock’s role and risk in the whole portfolio.","Because my retirement savings must support living expenses, I should avoid unnecessary trading and keep enough diversification and stability to withstand market swings."]}
